entity: US doctors paid $10K+ by drug companies: higher cost per claim and brand-name share across specialties (2024 data)
what_we_add: the 2024 refresh: 1.2-5.6x cost per claim at the $10K+ tier, brand-share rise in all 7 specialties, internal medicine $94 to $355
why: ProPublica and PLOS One state the same finding, same direction: payments track higher brand-name prescribing and cost, dose-response, across specialties - on 2014 data. Our 2024 numbers and the $10K tier are new. NBER's generic-transition result is a different measure, not a contradiction of the correlation claimed.
